//: Feature profile for this deployment. One switch per feature: `true` includes its schema fragment (the src/**/schema.sql declaring `-- feature: <id>`) and its code (src/features/<id>/). Some features are schema-only (plugins, jobs) and some are code-only (search, users-roles). Run `npm run build` after editing. Turning a feature OFF never drops existing tables — it only stops creating them on fresh installs.
